control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at P-4101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 7 December 2005 a planned spot check of P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the control of freeboard, beach width and decant not effective.
